claims.title: Local heating and reset: terminal ambiguity, cooling and functional recovery

quoted_fields.interface: Locate the actual damaged region, retain or isolate mechanical/fluid loads, direct heat without destroying healthy monitoring, recover a bounded cool state and verify useful function and critical stocks. The circuit model assumes two series ohmic elements, fixed current and independent lumped thermal nodes. The gas model assumes ideal air, a declared orifice law, finite isolated stock and known temperature/volume evolution. Apart from the source 0.5 A reference, these values are introduced rather than measured material, sensor or actuator properties.
quoted_fields.failure: The terminal-only counterexample depends on its stated ohmic and thermal assumptions. Optional taps require actual surviving wiring and calibration; local power still does not prove repair. The closure law is not measured polymer kinetics and cooldown is not a prescribed readiness limit. Surrogate holes are not calibrated cracks. Real creep, force, fatigue, adhesion and stock renewal remain unresolved. The existing source already combines detection, heating, sealing and electrical reset. No new material, sensor algorithm, working device, whole-cost advantage or all-sensor obstruction is established.
